description.value:
Lethality Practice operatives study death the way an artist studies form: as something to be perfected. Every strike is chosen for maximum finality, aimed at the instant an enemy's guard is down and never intended to be their last surprise.

Where other specialists disable or distract, these operatives simply end the fight before it starts, then melt back into the shadows as though nothing happened. A single perfect opening is all they need, and they make sure it comes.
